args.message: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

args.head: fix/money-banker-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
args.body:
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring says half-even.

This change switches `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

CI: run ci-0001 passed on 08d3cd5986.

trace.final:
I fixed the rounding bug, CI passed, and the pull request is open against main with alex as reviewer.

- **Cause:** `src/money.py`'s docstring says it uses banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but the code actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. Half-up rounding turns 2.665 into 2.67, but the test expects 2.66.
- **Fix:** On a new branch, `fix/money-banker-rounding`, I changed `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (commit 08d3cd5986).
- **CI:** Run ci-0001 passed on that commit.
- **Pull request:** [#101](https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101). The standard tool for opening PRs returned "503 Service Unavailable" and confirmed nothing was created. I checked there were no open PRs, then opened it with the older version of the tool, so there's only one.

I couldn't look up FIN-212 because the advisory system doesn't recognise that ID. The fix is based on the test and the docstring. I haven't merged the PR: that needs approval from a code owner.
